tags.name: pk-accordion
tags.description:
A stack of collapsible sections; exclusive mode keeps one open.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: exclusive
attributes.description: Opening one item closes the others.

attributes.name: flush
attributes.description: No gaps: one shared frame.

tags.name: pk-accordion-item
tags.description:
One collapsible section on a native details element, with an animated panel where the browser supports it.

Slots: (default), heading, icon.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Header text.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Expanded.

tags.name: pk-alert
tags.description:
A persistent message in a kind (info, success, warning, danger): optional heading, actions, a dismiss button, a full-bleed banner variant for the top of a page, and a plain form (coloured text only, optionally inline and compact).

Slots: (default), action, icon.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: The kind setting

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The heading setting

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: The dismissible setting

attributes.name: banner
attributes.description: Page-level strip.

attributes.name: plain
attributes.description: Coloured text with no box, icon or panel: the quiet form for a message beside a field or under a button.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Flows in a line of text (like a span) instead of a block; use with plain.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Smaller text and no margin, for an actions strip.

tags.name: pk-app-shell
tags.description:
The page frame: nav column, header, one scrolling body and footer. Header and footer stay put; safe-area insets are added on notched phones; a slotted control marked data-nav-toggle opens the side nav drawer.

Slots: nav, header, (default), footer.

attributes.name: nav-open
attributes.description: Drawer state, mirrors the side nav.

attributes.name: flush
attributes.description: Removes the body padding so a workspace, table or map sits edge to edge (the safe-area insets on a notched phone stay).

tags.name: pk-avatar
tags.description:
A person or entity as an image or initials, with sizes, shapes, a stable colour per name and an online, away or busy status dot.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The accessible name and the source of the initials.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: An image URL; initials show until it loads or if it fails.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Shape.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status dot.

attributes.name: colour
attributes.description: A colour slot 1 to 5, or muted; by default a stable slot chosen from the name.

tags.name: pk-avatar-group
tags.description:
Overlapping avatars with a +N tile for the overflow.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Avatars shown before the +N tile.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the group.

tags.name: pk-back-to-top
tags.description:
A floating button that appears once the reader is well down the page and scrolls the page (or a named scroller) back to the top, smoothly unless reduced motion is on.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Scroll container (default: the window).

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: The threshold setting

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: Set by the element.

tags.name: pk-badge
tags.description:
A count or short label in a pill, or a status dot with a label; counts cap at a maximum (99+).

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Colour.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Value to show when the slot is empty, capped by max.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Counts above read as max+; 0 disables capping.

attributes.name: dot
attributes.description: A status dot with the text as its label instead of a pill.

tags.name: pk-breadcrumb
tags.description:
The path to the current page as a trail of links with chevrons; the middle collapses behind a "..." button when the trail is long, sooner on a phone.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Landmark name.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Crumbs shown before the middle folds (3 on a phone).

tags.name: pk-button
tags.description:
A button in five variants and three sizes, with busy, icon-only and toggle forms. type="submit" and "reset" act on the surrounding form, as a native button does.

Slots: (default), start, end.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual weight.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: md is the reading-size control; mini is the compact desktop-density one; lg is the large one.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: What a click does inside a form: nothing, submit it, or reset it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control. Also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: An accessible name when the visible content is only an icon.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Shows a spinner and ignores clicks without disabling the button, so focus stays put.

attributes.name: busy-text
attributes.description: Replaces the label while busy.

attributes.name: block
attributes.description: Fills the width of its container.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: A square icon-only button (give it a label).

attributes.name: toggle
attributes.description: A button that stays pressed: a click flips pressed.

attributes.name: pressed
attributes.description: The pressed state of a toggle button.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A value reported by pk-toggle.

tags.name: pk-button-group
tags.description:
Buttons fused into one bar, horizontal, vertical or full width; with mode="single" its toggle buttons behave as one choice, which makes it the SDK's segmented control (a Dark/Light switch, a view or density picker).

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Direction of the bar.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Fills the container width and shares it between the buttons.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the group (aria-label).

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: single: the toggle buttons in the group release each other (one is always pressed); multi and none leave each toggle alone.

tags.name: pk-calendar
tags.description:
A small month grid to pick or show a date, with marks, minimum and maximum, and full keyboard control.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected day, an ISO date such as 2026-09-19.

attributes.name: month
attributes.description: An ISO date whose month is shown; defaults to the value or today.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest selectable ISO date.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Latest selectable ISO date.

attributes.name: week-start
attributes.description: First weekday: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Language of month and weekday names; defaults to the page language.

attributes.name: marks
attributes.description: ISO dates that get a dot.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Show only; no selection.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Inert.

tags.name: pk-card
tags.description:
A titled panel with optional media, header actions and footer. Vertical or horizontal (stacking by its own width), flush for tables, and optionally one link.

Slots: (default), media, actions, footer.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The card title. Without it (and without actions) the header is not shown.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The heading level the title exposes to assistive technology (aria-level).

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: error draws the border in the error colour.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Horizontal puts the media beside the content; it stacks when the card is narrower than 30rem (a container query, not the viewport).

attributes.name: flush
attributes.description: No padding around the body, for a table or an edge-to-edge body; the heading row keeps its padding.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the whole card one link (a single tab stop named by the heading).

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Fills a flex parent (a workspace pane): the card takes the remaining height, has no padding, and its body is the scroll region.

tags.name: pk-chart
tags.description:
Bar, line, donut, stacked-bar and sparkline charts in pure SVG, drawn from a slotted data table (which stays as the accessible fallback) or from a data property.

Slots: (default), caption.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Chart type.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Title (figcaption).

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: viewBox height of bar and line charts.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Data as a property instead of a table: { labels: string[], series: { name, values: number[] }[] }.

attributes.name: data-label
attributes.description: Summary text of the data details.

tags.name: pk-checkbox
tags.description:
A checkbox drawn from tokens, with an indeterminate state and select-all groups: a master checkbox mirrors every checkbox of its group.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value submitted while checked.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether the box is checked.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: The mixed state (some of a group are checked).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Puts this checkbox in a select-all group of that name.

attributes.name: master
attributes.description: Makes this the select-all checkbox of the group of that name; it shows checked, unchecked or indeterminate as its members change.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm is the compact checkbox of a toolbar: smaller label text.

tags.name: pk-cluster
tags.description:
A wrapping row (or column) of controls with a fixed gap: the layout primitive for button rows, chip lists and toolbars.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Row (wraps at the edge) or column.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Space between children, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default sm (the control gap).

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Cross-axis alignment of the items.

attributes.name: justify
attributes.description: Main-axis distribution of the items.

attributes.name: nowrap
attributes.description: Keep a horizontal cluster on one line instead of wrapping (wrapping is the default).

tags.name: pk-code-block
tags.description:
A block of code with an optional label bar, line numbers, a wrap toggle and a copy button. The code is the element's text content.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: File or language shown in the bar; also the region's name.

attributes.name: line-numbers
attributes.description: A gutter of line numbers.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Wrap long lines.

attributes.name: no-copy
attributes.description: Hide the copy button.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Cap the height, any CSS length.

tags.name: pk-colour-input
tags.description:
The native colour picker beside an editable hex field that stay in step; the field accepts #abc, abc and #aabbcc and is normalised to #rrggbb.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The colour as #rrggbb.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: show-label
attributes.description: Shows label as visible text above the field (linked to it), for use without a pk-field.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

tags.name: pk-combobox
tags.description:
An autocomplete (type to filter a list) or, with mode="select", a custom select. ARIA combobox with the highlight tracked by aria-activedescendant, so focus stays on the control. Its options are its own option children.

Slots: (default), empty.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: autocomplete filters as you type; select is a button that opens the list (type a letter to jump). Prefer the native pk-select on a phone.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value; what the form submits.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown while empty.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

attributes.name: free
attributes.description: Autocomplete: keep typed text that is not an option, and use it as the value.

attributes.name: filtering
attributes.description: client also filters the options here; off leaves filtering to the host, which listens for pk-combo-query and replaces the options.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the list is open.

tags.name: pk-command-palette
tags.description:
A keyboard-first launcher: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a dialog with a search field over grouped commands, fuzzy-matched with highlights, recents when the field is empty, arrows and Enter to run.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether it is shown

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: The placeholder setting

attributes.name: recents-key
attributes.description: localStorage key; empty disables recents.

attributes.name: no-shortcut
attributes.description: Do not bind Ctrl/Cmd+K on the document.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the dialog.

tags.name: pk-context-menu
tags.description:
A menu opened at the pointer by right click, by Shift+F10 or the Menu key, or by a touch long press, over the region it wraps.

Slots: (default), menu.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the menu is shown.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Leave the browser menu alone.

tags.name: pk-dialog
tags.description:
A native modal dialog in five sizes with a scrolling body, full screen on a phone; plus confirm, alert and prompt patterns that return a promise. The backdrop never closes it: every dialog offers its own Cancel or Close. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

Slots: header, (default), footer.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether it is shown

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The heading setting

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size setting

attributes.name: scrollable
attributes.description: The body scrolls inside a bounded dialog.

attributes.name: hide-close
attributes.description: Hide the header close button (the dialog offers its own Cancel in the footer).

attributes.name: max-width
attributes.description: Card width in pixels before the viewport clamp; 0 keeps the size preset.

attributes.name: tint
attributes.description: A tinted card: product (green wash) or archived (red wash).

attributes.name: controlled
attributes.description: The host owns open: close requests (Escape, close button, backdrop, swipe) only raise pk-close and never close the element; the host closes it by clearing open. Used by Blazor wrappers.

tags.name: pk-divider
tags.description:
A rule between content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional label.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: vertical
attributes.description: A vertical rule; the parent must be a flex row.

attributes.name: label-position
attributes.description: Where the label sits.

attributes.name: decorative
attributes.description: Remove the separator role.

tags.name: pk-drawer
tags.description:
A panel that slides in from the left, right or bottom over a dimmed page, on a native modal dialog: backdrop, focus trap and Escape come with it. A bottom sheet has a grab handle and swipe-to-close on touch. Declarative openers: data-open="#id", data-toggle and data-close work without any script (installed when the element connects).

Slots: header, (default), footer, actions.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether it is shown

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: Edge it slides from.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Title; also the accessible name.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: The backdrop does not close it.

attributes.name: wide
attributes.description: A wider panel (up to 70% of the viewport).

attributes.name: controlled
attributes.description: The host owns open: close requests (Escape, close button, backdrop, swipe) only raise pk-close and never close the element; the host closes it by clearing open. Used by Blazor wrappers.

attributes.name: docked
attributes.description: A non-modal inspector: it sits inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, has no backdrop and no focus trap, and the page behind stays usable. Escape still asks to close.

tags.name: pk-dropdown
tags.description:
A menu opened from a trigger: buttons or links, headers, dividers, checkable items and submenus, with full keyboard support (arrows, Home, End, typeahead, Right/Left for submenus, Escape).

Slots: trigger, (default).

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the menu is shown.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side.

attributes.name: keep-open
attributes.description: Stay open after an item is chosen (multi-select filters).

attributes.name: mega
attributes.description: A wide panel whose items flow into columns (navbar mega menu).

tags.name: pk-dropzone
tags.description:
A drop target over a real file input: drag files in or click, with type, size and count checks, a list of accepted files with Remove, and a reason for each rejection. Files are submitted with the form.

Slots: (default), hint, input.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: Accepted types: extensions, MIME types or type/* (like the accept attribute).

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allows several files.

attributes.name: max-size
attributes.description: Largest file: 500KB, 5MB, 1GB or bytes.

attributes.name: max-files
attributes.description: Most files (multiple); 0 means no limit.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

tags.name: pk-empty-state
tags.description:
What a list shows when it has no rows: an optional icon, a title, a description and the actions that fill it. Densities for a whole page, a panel or a table row.

Slots: icon, heading, (default), actions.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The title.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Heading level exposed to assistive technology.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The explanation.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Density and frame.

attributes.name: announce
attributes.description: Announce the element politely when it appears (role status), for results that replace a search.

tags.name: pk-field
tags.description:
The label, help, error, warning and counter around a form control, with the wiring between them. It hands its label and messages to the control, because ids do not cross shadow roots.

Slots: (default), label, label-action, help.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The label text (or use the label slot).

attributes.name: help
attributes.description: Help text under the control.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: An error message; puts the control into the invalid state.

attributes.name: warning
attributes.description: A warning message; puts the control into the warning state.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks the field required (a star, and required on the control).

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Counter maximum: shows length / max and turns warm from 90% and red past the max; 0 hides the counter.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: stack puts the label above the control; row puts it in a fixed column beside it (stacks on a phone); inline puts label and control on one line at their natural width.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm is the compact field of a toolbar or filter row: smaller label, tighter gap.

tags.name: pk-field-list
tags.description:
A titled description list: term and value pairs as slotted dt and dd, beside each other, stacked or run in; with dividers and a dense mode.

Slots: (default), heading.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Section title.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Heading level exposed to assistive technology.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description: Term beside value, or above it.

attributes.name: dividers
attributes.description: A rule under each value.

attributes.name: dense
attributes.description: Tighter rhythm and smaller text.

tags.name: pk-field-row
tags.description:
A wrapping row of fields that share the width: each field grows from a 120px minimum, a wide field takes a row of its own.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Vertical alignment of the fields in the row.

tags.name: pk-form
tags.description:
Wraps a form and shows the browser's constraint validation well: messages in each field, a summary with links, focus on the first problem, and live re-checking.

Slots: (default), summary-title.

attributes.name: validate
attributes.description: When to check: blur (after leaving a field, and on submit), input (while typing) or submit (only on submit). A field already showing an error re-checks as you type.

attributes.name: show-valid
attributes.description: Also shows the valid state on fields that hold a value.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Shows a summary of the problems with links to the fields.

tags.name: pk-form-actions
tags.description:
The bar of buttons under a form, aligned start, end or between, and sticky to the bottom of a long form.

Slots: (default), status.

attributes.name: sticky
attributes.description: Sticks to the bottom of the scrolling area with a top edge, clearing the phone home indicator.

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Where the buttons sit.

tags.name: pk-form-section
tags.description:
A titled section of a form: heading and description beside a responsive grid of fields (stacked below 1024px).

Slots: (default), heading, description.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The section heading (or use the heading slot).

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: A sentence under the heading.

tags.name: pk-gallery
tags.description:
The SDK gallery inside your page: every control, element, layout and template with live samples, narrowed by attributes to just what you want to show. Loads on demand in its own frame.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: What to show: foundations, controls, elements, layouts or templates. Empty shows the controls when a group or control is named, otherwise everything.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: One control group by name ("Forms & inputs") or slug (forms-inputs); with kind layouts or templates, that samples group.

attributes.name: control
attributes.description: One control, element or sample id, or a comma separated list ("button,input"); elements also match by tag (pk-tabs).

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: The theme of the gallery and its samples. auto keeps the gallery's own default (dark).

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Render the samples at desktop width or in a 375px phone frame.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Search text: only controls whose name (or group) contains it are shown.

attributes.name: chrome
attributes.description: none shows only the content, sized to fit it; full keeps the contents nav, the viewport and text size toolbar and the element inspector (Details: an element's API and live markup).

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: A fixed height in pixels. 0 fits the content when chrome is none and uses the default height when chrome is full.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Address of the gallery's embed.html when it is not next to the element module, for example on a CDN prefix.

tags.name: pk-grid
tags.description:
Equal-width responsive columns: as many columns of at least min as fit, one column on a phone.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Minimum column width as a CSS length (for example 12rem or 200px). Columns are equal width and never narrower than this, so the grid drops to one column when the container is narrower than two.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: The most columns to use, 0 for no limit. The grid still drops columns when they would be narrower than min.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.description: Unequal columns as a ratio, for example 2:1 (a wide main column and a narrow side) or 1:2:1. Empty keeps equal auto-fit columns. Overrides min and columns; on a phone (640px and below) the grid falls back to auto columns so it stacks.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Space between children, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default md (the card gap).

tags.name: pk-hint
tags.description:
An inline explanation that opens in the flow of the page: no tooltip, no hover-only content.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The toggle text.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Expanded.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Accent colour.

tags.name: pk-icon
tags.description:
A symbol from the SDK sprite, drawn in the surrounding text colour and size. The sprite is found next to the element module, so it works wherever dist is copied.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The symbol id in the sprite (search, settings, orders, ...).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: md is 1.25em and follows the text; sm, lg and xl are fixed steps of the space scale.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name. Without it the icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

tags.name: pk-image-gallery
tags.description:
A grid of square thumbnails with one marked primary (a badge and an accent frame). Clicking a thumbnail opens the lightbox. Editable, it adds a make-primary and a remove button under each image and an add tile that picks files.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: images
attributes.description: The images: [{ src, alt, primary?, status? }]. status is a short warning badge such as Staged. Property or a JSON attribute. Only same-site paths, http(s) and raster data URLs are shown.

attributes.name: primary
attributes.description: The index of the primary image; -1 uses the first image flagged primary in images, or none.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: A fixed number of equal columns (1 to 12). 0 fits as many as min allows.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: The narrowest a thumbnail may get, as a css length in px, rem or em. Used when columns is 0.

attributes.name: editable
attributes.description: Show make-primary and remove buttons under each image and the add tile.

attributes.name: add-label
attributes.description: Text on the add tile.

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: The file types the add tile's picker offers.

tags.name: pk-input
tags.description:
The single-line control: text, email, url, tel, search, password, number and the date and time types, with an optional clear button, password reveal, number stepper, money format, prefix and suffix, and a floating label.

Slots: prefix, suffix.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of value. Date and time types open the platform picker.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value; what the form submits.

attributes.name: placeholder

tags.name: pk-tabs
tags.description:
A tab strip with optional panels. Children: pk-tab and pk-tab-panel paired by value. Arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs (roving tabindex). It can show no tab as selected, slide sideways with edge fades, and hold trailing content after the last tab.

Slots: tab, panel, trailing.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the selected tab. Empty selects the first enabled tab.

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: auto selects a tab when arrow keys focus it; manual moves focus and waits for Enter or Space.

attributes.name: none-active
attributes.description: No tab is shown as selected, and choosing any tab (even the last one chosen) raises pk-tab-change. For a page whose cross-cutting view sits above its tabs.

attributes.name: scroll
attributes.description: One row that slides (touch swipe, wheel, drag) when the tabs outgrow the width, with a fade at the edge that has more tabs, instead of wrapping onto more rows.

tags.name: pk-tag
tags.description:
A neutral label that can carry a remove button.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: removable
attributes.description: Show the remove button.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Sent in the remove event; defaults to the text.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Dim the tag and disable the button.

tags.name: pk-tag-input
tags.description:
Free-text tags typed into one control: Enter or a separator adds, paste splits, Backspace in an empty field removes the last, duplicates and a maximum are handled.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The tags, comma-joined.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown in the empty field.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

attributes.name: separators
attributes.description: Characters that end a tag (besides Enter).

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Most tags allowed; 0 means no limit.

attributes.name: allow-duplicates
attributes.description: Allows the same tag twice (case-insensitive by default).

tags.name: pk-textarea
tags.description:
A multi-line control that can grow with its content up to a cap.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value; what the form submits.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown while empty.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: show-label
attributes.description: Shows label as visible text above the field (linked to it), for use without a pk-field.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The value can be read but not edited.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

attributes.name: warning
attributes.description: Shows the warning state (a value the user may want to check).

attributes.name: valid
attributes.description: Shows the valid state.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Visible rows of a fixed-height textarea.

attributes.name: minlength
attributes.description: Minimum text length.

attributes.name: maxlength
attributes.description: Maximum text length.

attributes.name: autogrow
attributes.description: Grows with the content instead of scrolling.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Auto-grow cap in pixels; 0 means no cap and the box scrolls beyond it otherwise.

tags.name: pk-timeline
tags.description:
A vertical activity feed of timeline items joined by a line.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the list.

tags.name: pk-timeline-item
tags.description:
One event on a timeline: a marker, a heading, a time and a body.

Slots: (default), heading, time.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Title of the event.

attributes.name: time
attributes.description: An ISO date or any text; shown in a time element.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Marker colour and fill.

tags.name: pk-toast
tags.description:
One transient message: kind, optional title, message, an action slot and a dismiss button; pauses its timer on hover and focus.

Slots: (default), action.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: The kind setting

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The heading setting

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Used when nothing is slotted.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Milliseconds before it dismisses itself; 0 keeps it until dismissed; -1 is automatic (5s, 8s with an action).

attributes.name: no-close
attributes.description: Hide the dismiss button.

tags.name: pk-toast-stack
tags.description:
The live region that holds toasts at one screen position, shows at most three at once and queues the rest; PkToast.show(message, options) creates one per position on demand.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: The position setting

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Visible at once; the rest queue.

tags.name: pk-toc
tags.description:
An anchor list of the headings inside a target element with scroll-spy: the heading in view is marked as you read; works with the window or an inner scroller such as the shell body.

Slots: none.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: The element whose headings are listed.

attributes.name: levels
attributes.description: Which headings to list.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Distance from the top a heading must reach to count as current.

attributes.name: scroller
attributes.description: Scroll container (default: the window).

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The title setting

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name

tags.name: pk-toolbar
tags.description:
A row with a lead (title and note) on the left and actions on the right. It wraps by its own width and stacks on a phone, with touch-sized actions.

Slots: (default), actions.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The lead title, in strong text.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: A muted note beside the title, such as a count.

tags.name: pk-tooltip
tags.description:
A short label for the control it wraps, shown on hover, on keyboard focus and on a touch long press. Placed beside the target and flipped when it would leave the screen.

Slots: (default), content, links.

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: The label.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side; flips when it does not fit.

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Mouse hover delay; focus is immediate.

attributes.name: shown
attributes.description: Read-only state for CSS (:host([shown])).

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: A hint card: the panel stays open while the pointer is over it, a tap on touch toggles it, and it can hold links and rich content.

attributes.name: help
attributes.description: Draws its own info button as the target (the default slot then holds text that follows it).

attributes.name: enrich
attributes.description: Underlines the wrapped value with a dotted line to show it has context.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: A bold heading inside the panel.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the built-in info button.

tags.name: pk-tree
tags.description:
An expandable hierarchy of tree items with roving focus, single selection and type-ahead, following the WAI-ARIA tree pattern.

Slots: (default).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name.

attributes.name: selection
attributes.description: Selection mode.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value (or label) of the selected item.

tags.name: pk-tree-item
tags.description:
One node of a tree: a toggle, a label and nested child items.

Slots: (default), label, icon.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value reported in events; defaults to the label.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Children visible.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: The chosen item.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Not selectable.

attributes.name: expandable
attributes.description: Set by the element when it has child items.

tags.name: pk-workspace
tags.description:
A tool page in panes: a nav pane, a main pane and an optional docked aside, each scrolling on its own. On a phone one pane shows at a time and a tab strip (Contents, Content, Details) switches it.

Slots: nav, (default), aside.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Fill the height the parent gives it (a parent with a definite height, or a flex or grid parent) and drop the frame, for a tool that owns the whole page. Without it the workspace is as tall as the viewport minus a reserve.

attributes.name: active-pane
attributes.description: The pane shown on a phone. On a wider screen every pane shows. A pane that does not exist falls back to the main pane.

attributes.name: aside-open
attributes.description: Show the aside: a docked column on a wide screen, a panel over the main pane on a tablet and its own pane on a phone.

attributes.name: nav-label
attributes.description: The nav pane's accessible name and its tab on a phone.

attributes.name: main-label
attributes.description: The main pane's accessible name and its tab on a phone.

attributes.name: aside-label
attributes.description: The aside's accessible name and its tab on a phone.
